I got full lists for six of the eight vendors. Linear's counts come from its signed DPA, since its trust-center page wouldn't load. Vercel's list wouldn't load at all, so I have no count for it. Locations and dates are as each vendor states them. I read the pages through a summarizing fetch tool, except Notion, which I read from its raw data.

| Vendor | Subprocessors listed | Last updated (as shown on page) |
|---|---|---|
| [Linear](https://linear.app/dpa) | 34 (DPA Exhibit B) | No date on the page. The DPA is signed 31 May 2025. |
| [Notion](https://notion.notion.site/Notion-s-List-of-Subprocessors-268fa5bcfa0f46b6bc29436b21676734) | 29 third parties, plus 7 Notion entities | 21 Sep 2026 |
| [Figma](https://www.figma.com/sub-processors/) | 52 third-party rows, plus 15 Figma entities | 22 Sep 2026 |
| [Vercel](https://security.vercel.com/subprocessors) | Not determined | Not shown |
| [Intercom](https://www.intercom.com/legal/subprocessors-list) | 14 third parties, plus 4 Intercom entities | No update date. The effective date is 25 Jun 2026. |
| [Retool](https://docs.retool.com/legal/subprocessors) | 11 unique (13 rows), plus 1 UK affiliate | 29 Jul 2026 |
| [Airtable](https://www.airtable.com/company/subprocessors) | 24 rows (23 unique), plus 3 affiliates | 25 Aug 2026 |
| [Loom (Atlassian's all-products list)](https://www.atlassian.com/legal/sub-processors) | 9 mapped to Loom | No update date. The effective date is 15 May 2026. |

## Located outside the US/EU
- **Linear:** None are listed outside the US/EU. Cloudflare is listed as "Global".
- **Notion:**
  - Mathpix: US, Germany and Singapore.
  - X.AI: US and UK.
  - Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Baseten, Modal and Cloudflare: "Global".
  - AWS, Confluent, Turbopuffer, StarTree, Fivetran and PlanetScale: processing in Korea and/or Japan, in addition to the US/EU.
  - Notion's own entities are in India, Japan, Australia, the UK and South Korea.
- **Figma:**
  - IntouchCX: Canada and the Philippines.
  - BytePlus and Enhancor: EU, Indonesia and Malaysia.
  - Kling AI: Singapore.
  - Lightricks: EU, Israel, UK and US.
  - Figma's own entities are in Australia, Brazil, Canada, India, New Zealand, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Israel (Weavy) and the UK.
  - The AI providers marked with an asterisk may route requests through "global data centers". The page says data is processed in volatile memory and the cache clears within two hours.
- **Intercom:**
  - There is an Australian hosting option, and AWS, Snowflake, Cloudflare, PlanetScale and Ably can process there.
  - Intercom Software Australia Pty Ltd is an affiliate.
  - Intercom Software UK Limited is also an affiliate.
- **Retool:** Every third party is US-only. The one exception is the Retool UK Limited affiliate, whose location isn't given.
- **Airtable:**
  - PartnerHero: US, Germany, Honduras, Romania and the Philippines.
  - AWS and Google (AI): "Global".
  - AWS has Australia data residency for customers who choose it.
  - Affiliates in Australia, Canada and the UK.
- **Loom:**
  - AWS regions include Canada, Australia, Singapore, South Korea, India, Japan, the UK and Switzerland.
  - PartnerHero: Philippines, Romania and South Africa.

## Caveats
- **Linear:** Linear's [trust center](https://trust.linear.app/subprocessors) is probably the live list, but it didn't render for me. The DPA exhibit may be out of date.
- **Vercel:**
  - Vercel's old `/legal/sub-processors` URL now redirects to its [security portal](https://security.vercel.com/?itemName=legal&itemUid=e3fae2ca-94a9-416b-b577-5c90e382df57). That page shows only about 11 names, with no locations or dates, and it directs readers to the trust center for the full list.
  - You'll need to open it in a browser, or request the list from Vercel.
- **Conflicting dates:** Search snippets gave different "updated" dates for Figma (7 Aug 2026) and Airtable (6 Jul 2026). I used the dates from the pages I fetched, which are newer.
- **Loom:** Loom has no list of its own, and the 9 are the entries I could confidently map to it. One ambiguous Google Vertex AI entry was excluded.
- **Entity headquarters:** I've kept to the locations the vendors state. A few entities are headquartered elsewhere but listed as US, for example Gong.io Ltd and Bright Data Ltd (Israel).

Sources:
- [Linear DPA](https://linear.app/dpa)
- [Linear trust center](https://trust.linear.app/subprocessors)
- [Notion subprocessors](https://notion.notion.site/Notion-s-List-of-Subprocessors-268fa5bcfa0f46b6bc29436b21676734)
- [Figma sub-processors](https://www.figma.com/sub-processors/)
- [Vercel security portal](https://security.vercel.com/subprocessors)
- [Intercom subprocessors](https://www.intercom.com/legal/subprocessors-list)
- [Retool subprocessors](https://docs.retool.com/legal/subprocessors)
- [Airtable subprocessors](https://www.airtable.com/company/subprocessors)
- [Atlassian sub-processors](https://www.atlassian.com/legal/sub-processors)
